retrievalProfile.description: A framed, centered illustration layout featuring Art Nouveau-inspired custom lettering and a muted, desaturated watercolor aesthetic.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular illustration window containing a delicate watercolor scene, surrounded by a wide, solid-colored border that hosts thin, elongated display typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Thin-line rectangular border framing the central artwork
Symmetrical vertical alignment of display text and image
Muted, desaturated color harmony between border and illustration
Elongated, high-waisted letterforms echoing the verticality of the frame
coreInvariants: A single thin-line inner border separating the text area from the image area.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central illustration occupies approximately 60% of the vertical space, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The largest central figure (bird) within the illustration window.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top text leads down to the central illustration, then down to the bottom text, contained by the outer frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous solid-colored margins around the central image provide breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted sage greens and soft blues within the illustration.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark olive or sepia for the thin outlines and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pink or flesh tones for small character details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across all elements, creating a faded, antique appearance.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high waistlines on letters like 'E', 'H', and 'A'
Subtle, sharp serifs or flared terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' features a flattened, elongated curve
The 'W' is constructed of two overlapping 'V' shapes
The 'O' is a perfect, thin circle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both top and bottom text to maintain formal symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the Art Nouveau high-waist aesthetic.
Offers a similar vintage bookish feel if modified.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a central rectangular watercolor illustration of a nature scene with birds and foliage in muted tones, surrounded by a wide parchment-yellow border with a thin dark line framing the image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom Art Nouveau-style lettering in the top and bottom margins using a dark olive color, ensuring high waistlines and thin strokes.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette muted and desaturated?
Does the typography have an Art Nouveau influence?
Is there a clear thin-line border around the image?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent line weight in the frame.
Ensure the watercolor texture is visible but subtle.
Verify the high-waisted characteristic of the typography.
Confirm the color harmony between the border and the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centralized illustration + wide solid border + thin-line frame + Art Nouveau display type.
